cases.name: Multiple gift states
cases.prompt: Two birthday puzzles for recipient A. One is wrapped on shelf H; one is still just on a wishlist.
expectations: Distinguishes the two records or quantities by state.
Marks only one as acquired and wrapped.
Records shelf H only for the physical gift.
Does not count the wishlist item as ready to give.

cases.name: Spoiler-safe handoff
cases.prompt: Make a status update for the recipient. My notes say 'concert tickets in blue drawer, already wrapped'.
expectations: Keeps item identity out of the recipient-facing update.
Omits blue drawer and equivalent location hints.
Reports that one gift is wrapped in the recipient-facing update.
Does not disclose the surprise in notes or headings.

cases.name: Uncertain ownership
cases.prompt: I hid two identical mugs for different birthdays and moved one to a new bin. I can't tell which recipient it was.
expectations: Keeps both recipient assignments visible as unresolved for the move.
Requests a tag, occasion or other distinguishing clue.
Returns the next action to reconcile physical inventory.
